derivation: Locate the unique UnpackManifest invalid-signature string and its RIP-relative reference in this binary. PE exception entries bound that caller. Its direct verifier call leads to the separately bounded wrapper, whose call/test/jns and result-byte store identify the normalization instruction. Confirm the unique instruction sequence, source hash, resource-cache index and deterministic target independently. No offsets were copied from a different build.

instructions.meaning: Initialize result byte to false before any verification operation.
Only nonnegative results jump to normalization; negative results retain the error-string path.
The negative-result error path jumps to the existing epilogue, bypassing normalization.
Normalize to al then store the result through r12; replace only setne al.
UnpackManifest invokes this exact verifier wrapper.
Require an empty error string and true result byte; otherwise set the failure flag bl.
Skip the invalid-signature message only when the combined failure flag is false.
Load the exact UnpackManifest invalid-signature message.

acceptance.nativeProfileScope: Manifest result normalization and deterministic PE checksum/certificate-overlay cleanup on copies.
acceptance.trustPolicy: This profile does not alter source Authenticode validation, Windows/Wine trust probes or client launch requirements.
